notes.title: Steam Achievements
notes.notes:
Hi,

zzzzz has been updated and Steam Achievements are now supported!

Six new achievements were added.

Thanks for playing zzzzz, and good luck getting them all!

notes.title: zzzzz Update + Steam Deck Playable
notes.notes:
Hello,

This is just a small post to announce that a new zzzzz update is now live.

[h1]Content:[/h1]

1) The death system is changed. Now, if you die at a certain level, you go back to the previous one, so it's not an instant game over anymore (unless you're at level 1 or 2);

2) Change in the main soundtrack and some sound effects;

3) Collision change: now if you collide with certain enemies, you no longer instantly dies. 

We also we'd like to inform that zzzzz is playable on the Steam Deck. If you have one and managed to play it, please share with us!

If you have any questions regarding this update or ideas for possible future ones, please share it as well!

Thank you
